notes: USER INPUTS: one 75 V, 18.75 kW SPB module, two-level three-phase inverter, continuous SVM, m=1.15, 10-100 kHz, efficiency >99.5%, coolant 60 C, Tj ceiling 125 C.
Modulation convention: Vphase_peak=m*Vdc/2; confirm this convention for your controller.
ASSUMPTIONS: power factor 1.0, zero phase-current ripple, 5 ns on/off overlap, 20 ns deadtime, 2 V reverse drop.
THERMAL ASSUMPTIONS: common cold plate 0.1 K/W from plate to local coolant; individual TIM 0.5 K/W; hottest-device loss multiplier 1.2.
coolant_temperature_c means local cooling-water temperature; sink_to_ambient means shared cold-plate-to-water resistance, not air cooling.
Eoss about 3.2 uJ at 75 V and hot Rds multiplier 1.65 at 125 C are approximate visual readings from datasheet page 3 Figures 6 and 9, not guaranteed values.
Maximum Rds 1 mOhm at 25 C is multiplied by 1.65. Gate charge max 34 nC characterized at 50 V is used as an approximation at 75 V.
N is devices per switch position; total count is 6N. All positions have equal N; average sharing is ideal. Hottest-device multiplier is a thermal allowance only.
Other losses are zero pending estimates: efficiency is a modeled upper estimate, not demonstrated complete module efficiency.
System 1200 V/300 kW values are context only. No electrical or hydraulic series/parallel interconnection is inferred.
Provisional user design cap: at most six EPC2361 devices per switch position.
All scenario inductances are assumptions, not extracted EPC9186 or user PCB values.
Branch_nh denotes an entire local commutation branch; shared_nh includes common high-frequency paths counted once.
The equal-current coupled-branch approximation is L_eff=L_shared+L_branch*(1+(N-1)*k)/N.
Gate common-source inductance must also be explicitly represented in a transient circuit without double-counting it in the branch total.
These are bookkeeping/common-mode estimates, not multi-device SPICE results or field-solver extraction.
